scope: Theorem 13.11 (A guarded planar observation with unrestricted pressure) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 69. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On R3, the fixed label (−4, 0, 0) and fixed box (−1, 2)2 × (−1, 1) realize halting by a compactly supported general force with zero initial velocity and prescribed pressure and all mixed derivatives bounded. One choice is periodic after time one. A separate choice satisfies ∥f(t)∥∞ = O((1 + t)−2/3) and f ∈ L2([0, ∞) × R3). Uniqueness holds among smooth competitors with u ∈ C([0, T]; H2) ∩ C1([0, T]; L2) and bounded u, ∇u on each finite interval, without any spatial integrability condition on pressure. Pressure is unique modulo a function of time.
